questions.prompt: Which method prints text without appending a newline?
questions.explanation: Console.Write outputs text without adding a newline, keeping the cursor on the same line.
WriteLine prints the text and then appends a newline character.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank to write Hello without a newline
Which escape sequence creates a new line in the output?
questions.explanation: The \n escape sequence inserts a newline (line feed) in the output.

questions.prompt: Print: Hello Alice using string interpolation
Arrange the code to print Hello then World on separate lines
questions.explanation: Each WriteLine call prints on its own line.

questions.prompt: What symbol is used for string interpolation in C#?
questions.explanation: The $ prefix before a string enables string interpolation, allowing expressions inside { }.

questions.prompt: In Console.WriteLine("{0} {1}", a, b), what does {0} refer to?
options: The first argument after the format string
questions.explanation: {0} is replaced by the first argument (a), {1} by the second (b).
